g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the 20-minute reward before an optional game. The decline and ad-failure fields leave the article unchanged.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 20 minutes of ad-free reading, not cash or transferable value.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger event counts article opens; it does not use chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal does not cap or lock free reading; the decline path keeps the article as it is.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a banner on the s12 article screen, which the model rates content safe.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As a product change, ad-free reading benefits the player in the observed article-reading core flows f1 and f2.

c2_evidence.reason: The 'what makes it work here' field claims every article has several display blocks, but mechanic m2 supports only one or more blocks per article. That present-day claim exceeds the observed evidence.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 20 minutes, and the model does not establish a paid ad-free benefit that it would give away without a limit.

c5_moment.reason: The placement is a slim banner when the third article opens, not an interruption in the middle of reading.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow uses a sponsored game triggered by a detectable article-open event, and the ad-failure field says nothing changes if play cannot be confirmed.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the s12 article screen and the sponsored cards and display ads documented in m2.

other_concern: The claim that one completed game will outweigh the article-ad views it replaces is an unverified revenue forecast.
